train_domain_generalization_model: train a domain generalization model on a dataset using ERM or another algorithm with configurable hyperparameters
train_domain_adaptation_model: train a domain adaptation model using unlabeled test environment samples for unsupervised domain adaptation
configure_hyperparameters: configure default or random hyperparameters for a specific algorithm and dataset using seed-based selection
split_datasets_into_envs: split dataset environments into in-split, out-split, and uda-split with configurable holdout fractions
save_model_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with args, hparams, and state dict to a pickle file at specified steps
